description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Zealous Lorecaster.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Zealous Lorecaster from exile to the battlefield.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
